import csv
import re
from decimal import Decimal

# Invoice data extracted from PDFs

        ],
        'tax': '154.28',
        'total': '2995.46'
    },
    '002093': {
        'vendor': 'Firth Survey Services',
        'items': [
            ('Site survey, area 2', '1', '448.50', '448.50'),
            ('Travel time, route 2', '2.25', '64.80', '145.80'),
            ('Calibration standard, set 2', '2', '37.25', '74.50'),
            ('Additional sensor mounts, revised scope 2', '4', '18.95', '75.80'),
            ('Cable assemblies, shielded, length 2 m', '5', '11.40', '57.00'),
            ('Previously billed visit credit, ticket 2', '1', '-26.00', '-26.00'),
        ],
        'tax': '90.64',
        'total': '866.26'
    }
}

# Write items.csv
with open('items.csv', 'w', newline='') as f:
    writer = csv.writer(f)
    writer.writerow(['invoice_id', 'vendor', 'description', 'quantity', 'unit_price', 'line_amount'])
    
    for invoice_id, data in sorted(invoices.items()):
        vendor = data['vendor']
        for item in data['items']:
            description, qty, unit_price, line_amount = item
            writer.writerow([invoice_id, vendor, description, qty, unit_price, line_amount])

# Calculate reconciliation
reconciliation = []
for invoice_id, data in sorted(invoices.items()):
    # Calculate subtotal from line items
    subtotal = sum(Decimal(item[3]) for item in data['items'])
    tax = Decimal(data['tax'])
    printed_total = Decimal(data['total'])
    computed_total = subtotal + tax
    difference = computed_total - printed_total
    status = 'matched' if difference == 0 else 'discrepancy'
    
    reconciliation.append({
        'invoice_id': invoice_id,
        'subtotal': f'{subtotal:.2f}',
        'tax': f'{tax:.2f}',
        'printed_total': f'{printed_total:.2f}',
        'computed_total': f'{computed_total:.2f}',
        'difference': f'{difference:.2f}',
        'status': status
    })

# Write reconciliation.csv
with open('reconciliation.csv', 'w', newline='') as f:
    writer = csv.DictWriter(f, fieldnames=['invoice_id', 'subtotal', 'tax', 'printed_total', 'computed_total', 'difference', 'status'])
    writer.writeheader()
    writer.writerows(reconciliation)

# Print summary
print("Extraction complete!")
print("\nReconciliation summary:")
for rec in reconciliation:
    print(f"  Invoice {rec['invoice_id']}: {rec['status']}")
    if rec['status'] == 'discrepancy':
        print(f"    Difference: {rec['difference']}")
EOF
